title: Netherwing: Rescue, Disguise, and Liberation
summary: A kindness to the Netherwing becomes a rescue, an oath and a dangerous disguise. Within the Dragonmaw’s camp, trust carries the seeker toward exposure and an unexpected escape.
opening: In the violet fields of Shadowmoon Valley, a stranger is asked to help a troubled flight. Beyond the first rescue waits a larger risk: to wear the enemy’s face long enough to learn how far its power reaches.

chapters.title: The captive flight
chapters.body:
Beneath Shadowmoon’s violet sky, Mordenai asked a stranger for kindness. The Netherwing drakes had been disturbed and would not easily trust an offered hand. Prey from the Rocknail hunt was brought to feed them. Before the flight could believe in an ally, someone had to answer an immediate need. Among dark stone and green light, the campaign began with care.

When that first kindness was answered, Mordenai pointed toward Neltharaku. The drake crossed the air above the fields, beyond roads and gates. The seeker found him beneath Shadowmoon’s broken horizon. From the feeding of wary creatures, the journey rose toward one who could speak of the flight’s suffering and the power that held its kin.

Neltharaku spoke of the Dragonmaw forcing Netherwing drakes into service. His people lived beneath another clan’s hand. He asked the seeker to trouble the fortress while he prepared a way to reach those still bound. The kindness offered among the fields had become a call to act, carrying the stranger toward a captivity that reached beyond one drake’s grief.

At Dragonmaw Fortress, the seeker struck the clan’s operation to draw attention away while Neltharaku prepared. The fortress did not fall. A narrow opening had been bought within hostile ground, and the flight’s plan still had to find its means. Beneath the captors’ walls, disturbance offered time for a hope that could not yet free those held inside.

Neltharaku’s plan led to Netherwing Ledge. Amid the Dragonmaw presence, Nethervine crystals were gathered from the broken island. The drake would prepare their power for the work ahead. What had been taken from contested ground could become a means of release, carrying the search from a brief disturbance toward the bonds that held his kin.

Neltharaku gave the crystals power to reach the enslaved drakes’ bonds. At the fortress, the seeker used them to free Netherwing who turned against their captors. Within the clan’s own camp, its forced servants became opponents. Other captives still remained, but those released could now fight beside the stranger whose first help had been offered without a blade.

Neltharaku’s mate Karynaku remained captive high at the fortress. She could speak, though her chains sapped her strength. Zuluhed the Whacked held the key. The larger captivity had narrowed to one drake whose voice could still guide her rescuers. Beyond the freedom already won, the flight’s hope now rested upon reaching the chieftain and opening the restraint he kept.

The seeker confronted Zuluhed, defeated him and recovered Karynaku’s key. Her chains opened. The fortress still sheltered the Dragonmaw’s wider operation, but the drake was free of the restraint that had drained her strength. The way led back toward the fields, carrying an answer to Neltharaku’s plea for the mate who had remained beyond his reach.

Karynaku offered to return the seeker to Mordenai. The Netherwing recognized an ally in the stranger who had fed their kin, troubled the fortress and broken her chains. Trust had been earned within a valley still dangerous to the flight. The first rescue now stood behind a wider promise: to help those whose homeland remained beneath the Dragonmaw’s hand.

chapters.title: Service beneath a borrowed face
chapters.body:
Mordenai called the new ally back with a greater plea. The Netherwing had lost their lands, and their children had been taken into slavery or worse. He asked for an oath to help reclaim their home and guard the flight. The first rescue had opened a wider duty. The seeker now accepted a place within the struggle against the Dragonmaw’s power.

Netherwing magic cloaked the seeker as a Dragonmaw fel orc. With Illidari service papers prepared for Mor’ghor, the disguised ally entered the base camp. Mordenai warned that some sentries could see through the borrowed appearance. The papers were accepted, and the seeker joined the clan’s workers, carrying the flight’s oath beneath orders that concealed its purpose.

Within the camp, Yarzill the Merc revealed himself as a friend to the hidden ally. The goblin’s presence offered a contact among workers who believed the new recruit served the clan. The oath no longer rested upon one disguise alone. A companion stood inside the operation, carrying a purpose the Dragonmaw had not recognized.

Another search among the Netherwing Mines uncovered plans attributed to Murkblood workers. An overseer spoke of revolt against the Dragonmaw and said the clan supplied Illidan’s forces while selling other goods. He suspected outside buyers, even the Black Dragonflight, but could name none with certainty. Beneath the ledge’s labor, another people sought release from the same captors.

Work within the ledge brought the disguised ally deeper into Dragonmaw confidence. At last, Varkule sent the seeker to Mor’ghor. The leader announced a first Highlord and promised that Illidan himself would come to perform the promotion. What had begun as a concealed oath to the Netherwing now approached the gaze of the master whose servants believed the impostor their own.

chapters.title: The Highlord exposed
chapters.body:
Illidan appeared before the gathered camp and saw through the disguise. His anger struck Mor’ghor, then turned toward the seeker. The impostor was to be killed. Mor’ghor answered with threats of vengeance. The promised promotion had become a sentence, and the borrowed face that won entry offered no shelter once its truth was known.

Before Mor’ghor could carry out the threat, Yarzill intervened. The goblin’s disguise fell away, revealing a Netherwing drake. He bore the adventurer out of danger and flew to Shattrath. The camp’s concealment had failed, but its hidden ally preserved the seeker’s life. Beyond Shadowmoon, the rescued stranger could carry the flight’s struggle to those waiting in the city.

In Shattrath’s Lower City, Barthamus received the survivor and heard that the Dragonmaw operation had been exposed. The Netherwing offered companionship in return for the aid they had received. A drake could join the adventurer’s road. The flight’s dangers had not all ended, yet the stranger who first answered a need among Shadowmoon’s fields no longer had to travel alone.
